channel.title: Contractor UK Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Contractor UK Limited (contractoruk.com)

item.title: ‘Make Work Pay…’ heralds a new era for umbrella company compliance
item.description: The open consultation ‘Make Work Pay: Modernising the Agency Work Regulatory Framework,’ marks a HUGE step towards ending the ‘grey area’ for contractors.

item.title: Signs of IT contractor jobs uplift softened in January 2026
item.description: REC finds IT contractor demand inched downwards in January, but Reed tells ContractorUK it isn’t stalling, is consistent, and still offers premiums.

item.title: To escalate or wait? With late payment, even month two is too late
item.description: The Small Business Commissioner’s trumpeting may sound like payment times are improving, but actually, we face a £26billion issue that the government has yet to find its voice about.

item.title: Changes to non-compete clauses in employment contracts require ministers to tread carefully
item.description: Amid practical unknowns and the risk of unintended consequences, the government would do well to remember it already has a highly productive mobile group of workers.

item.title: IR35 & Control in 2026/27: Explainer for Contractors
item.description: Here’s the four main ways Control under IR35 will be tested for in contractors’ 2026/27 engagements, and how to assess it yourself.

item.title: Why Rupert Lowe MP’s Restore Britain has it wrong on IR35
item.description: Four reasons why contractors should not be taken in by ‘Scrap IR35’ rhetoric, almost regardless of which political quarter it comes from.

item.title: IR35 & Right of Substitution in 2026/27: Explainer for Contractors
item.description: Whether it’s you or the client who sets your IR35 status, being able to send Dylan in your place is key for self-employment. Just don’t do it for the sake of it.

item.title: Post Office hit with ‘crazy’ £104million HMRC bill for IR35 failings
item.description: The Post Office Ltd becomes the public sector’s single largest off-payroll working compliance failure, ‘sending a clear message’ to the private sector that robust IR35 processes are ‘essential rather than optional.’

item.title: IR35 & Mutuality of Obligation in 2026/27: Explainer for Contractors
item.description: How a court case changes what’s now relevant to contractors trying to fight their corner on MOO.

item.title: How to run a limited company — efficiently: smarter profit strategies
item.description: Retain. Share. Plan. Contractors employing a bit of thoughtfulness over drawing out every pound possible will likely be on the money on Tuesday, too.
